text: Are you all right?! What happened?
Dragon...there's a dragon...It has taken some\nvillagers hostage and occupied the center of the\nvillage...Please help them...
A dragon?! They started attacking our village...\nHow dare they are!!
I thought dragons and weredragons are similar.\nHow come you guys are not on good terms?
Similar my ass! They look nothing like us!!
Oh gosh! I'm sorry.\nYou don't have to get that angry.
When the world you come from crumbled, many\ndragons fell into this world.
They used to serve gods and manage the nature in\nyour world, but since they are no longer bound to\ndo that, they do so many bad things here...
Well, there are a few that still love and look up\nto the gods and your world tho. They're willing to\nfight against those bad dragons with us...
Anyway, let's just go to the center of the village\nnow to save those taken hostage!\nThis way!
